text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah~, no way. I am definitely not okay~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Man, my head's been hurting for a while now...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"And with that, I'm heading to sleep.
I'll take the sofa."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Tell the teachers and stuff
that I'm restin' here, 'kay~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora was plagued by
a headache for a while.
